techniques: Writing Task 2: two-part question
Answer BOTH parts. For causes/solutions, explain at least two key causes and corresponding practical responses.
Trả lời đủ cả hai vế. Với nguyên nhân/giải pháp, phát triển nguyên nhân và giải pháp có liên hệ, không sa đà vào một bên.
Writing: conclusion
Restate your position/main findings in different words; do not introduce a new reason or an unsupported statistic.
Kết luận nhắc lại luận điểm bằng diễn đạt khác; không thêm lý do mới hoặc số liệu thiếu nguồn.
Writing: linking ideas
Use connectors accurately: furthermore adds; however contrasts; therefore gives a result; for example illustrates.
Dùng từ nối theo chức năng: furthermore bổ sung; however đối lập; therefore kết quả; for example nêu ví dụ.
Grammar: present perfect vs past simple
Present perfect: past activity with a present result (People have damaged forests). Past simple: completed time (A storm destroyed the bridge last year).
Hiện tại hoàn thành nói hành động quá khứ có ảnh hưởng hiện tại; quá khứ đơn gắn với thời điểm đã kết thúc.
Listening: note completion
Identify each heading (origin/habitat/diet/appearance/threats), predict word class, listen for signposts, check singular/plural and word limit.
Nhận biết tiêu đề, dự đoán từ loại, nghe từ báo hiệu chuyển ý và kiểm tra số ít/số nhiều cùng giới hạn từ.
Listening: distractors
An earlier number or animal may be corrected. Give the FINAL confirmed information and avoid answers not supported by the recording.
Thông tin nhắc đầu có thể là bẫy và bị sửa sau; chỉ chọn thông tin xác nhận sau cùng, không suy đoán.
Speaking Part 2
Spend 1 minute making notes: name, appearance, food, habitat, feelings and one memorable fact. Speak for 1–2 minutes.
Dùng 1 phút ghi từ khóa: tên con vật, ngoại hình, thức ăn, nơi sống, cảm nghĩ, một chi tiết đáng nhớ. Nói 1–2 phút.
Speaking Part 3
Start with a direct answer, give a reason and a concrete example. Use cautious language rather than unsupported absolute claims.
Trả lời trực tiếp, nêu lý do và ví dụ; hạn chế tuyệt đối hóa thiếu căn cứ.
Speaking: pets and zoos
Discuss animal welfare, responsibility, education, conservation, safety and the distinction between domesticated and wild animals.
Khai thác phúc lợi động vật, trách nhiệm, giáo dục, bảo tồn, an toàn; phân biệt thú nuôi và động vật hoang dã.

items.question_vi: Điền cụm loài nguy cấp.
items.explanation_en: Endangered modifies an animal or plant species at risk.
items.explanation_vi: Endangered đi với species (loài), không phải energy.

items.question_en: Complete: renewable ____ (energy / pollution).
items.question_vi: Điền cụm năng lượng tái tạo.
items.explanation_en: Solar and wind are forms of renewable energy.
items.explanation_vi: Điện mặt trời và gió là năng lượng tái tạo.

items.question_en: Complete: fossil ____ (fuels / habitats).
items.question_vi: Điền nhiên liệu hóa thạch.
items.explanation_en: Coal, oil and gas are fossil fuels.
items.explanation_vi: Than, dầu và khí đốt là nhiên liệu hóa thạch.

items.question_en: Complete: global ____ (warming / species).
items.question_vi: Điền nóng lên toàn cầu.
items.explanation_en: Global warming refers to long-term global temperature increase.
items.explanation_vi: Global warming chỉ xu hướng nhiệt độ Trái Đất tăng.

items.question_en: Complete: natural ____ (habitats / warming).
items.question_vi: Điền môi trường sống tự nhiên.
items.explanation_en: Habitats are places where animals live naturally.
items.explanation_vi: Habitat là nơi loài vật sinh sống.

items.question_en: Complete: air ____ (pollution / climate).
items.question_vi: Điền ô nhiễm không khí.
items.explanation_en: Air pollution names harmful substances in the air.
items.explanation_vi: Air pollution là ô nhiễm không khí.

activities.title: Write short conclusion sentences
activities.instruction_en: Use each collocation in a conclusion sentence.
activities.instruction_vi: Dùng từng cụm từ viết câu kết luận ngắn.

items.question_en: Conclude an essay about protecting endangered species.
items.question_vi: Viết câu chốt cho chủ đề bảo vệ loài nguy cấp.
items.answer: In conclusion, protecting natural habitats is essential if we want endangered species to survive.
items.explanation_en: Summarises a practical central solution without adding new evidence.
items.explanation_vi: Tóm tắt giải pháp chính mà không thêm luận cứ mới.

items.question_en: Conclude an essay about fossil fuels and cleaner alternatives.
items.question_vi: Viết câu kết luận về nhiên liệu hóa thạch và năng lượng sạch.
items.answer: To sum up, governments should gradually reduce fossil fuel use and invest in renewable energy.
items.explanation_en: Gives a final recommendation connected to the discussion.
items.explanation_vi: Nêu khuyến nghị gắn với vấn đề đã bàn.

items.question_en: Is “There are 500 new species in my city” suitable as a new statistic in a conclusion? YES/NO.
items.question_vi: Có nên tự thêm số liệu mới ở kết luận?
items.explanation_en: Conclusions should not introduce unsupported data.
items.explanation_vi: Không đưa số liệu chưa được trình bày, đặc biệt nếu không có nguồn.

items.question_en: Choose an appropriate closing phrase: In conclusion / For example.
items.question_vi: Chọn từ mở kết luận.
items.explanation_en: For example introduces evidence, not the final summary.
items.explanation_vi: For example dùng cho ví dụ, không phải cụm chốt bài.

activities.title: Parts of a conclusion
activities.instruction_en: Decide what belongs in a short IELTS Task 2 conclusion.
activities.instruction_vi: Xác định thành phần cần có của kết luận.

items.question_en: Should a conclusion briefly restate the position? YES/NO.
items.question_vi: Kết luận có nhắc lại quan điểm không?
items.explanation_en: Restatement tells the examiner the final stance.
items.explanation_vi: Viết lại lập trường để bài rõ ý.

items.question_en: Should a conclusion introduce a completely new main argument? YES/NO.
items.question_vi: Có thêm luận điểm chính mới ở kết luận không?
items.explanation_en: New ideas belong in the body where evidence can be developed.
items.explanation_vi: Ý mới nên ở thân bài để được giải thích.

items.question_en: A final recommendation may be useful when appropriate. TRUE/FALSE.
items.question_vi: Đề xuất cuối có thể phù hợp tùy đề.
items.explanation_en: It is acceptable when it follows from the existing argument.
items.explanation_vi: Khuyến nghị hợp lý khi rút ra từ ý đã bàn.

items.question_en: Choose better style: A “We can save the world easily.” B “Coordinated action could reduce environmental damage.”
items.question_vi: Chọn kết luận thận trọng, học thuật.
items.explanation_en: B avoids an exaggerated promise.
items.explanation_vi: B không cường điệu bảo đảm cứu cả thế giới dễ dàng.

items.question_en: Should a conclusion normally be longer than the two body paragraphs? YES/NO.
items.question_vi: Kết luận có nên dài hơn thân bài?
items.explanation_en: A concise summary is more effective.
items.explanation_vi: Kết luận nên ngắn gọn, không lặp toàn bộ phân tích.

activities.title: Evaluate conclusion quality
activities.instruction_en: Choose the conclusion that answers the essay question without irrelevant material.
activities.instruction_vi: Chọn kết luận bám đề và không lan man.

items.question_en: Topic: “Individuals can protect the environment.” A “To conclude, individuals can reduce waste and save energy, although governments also have responsibilities.” B “I bought a bicycle in 2017.”
items.question_vi: Kết luận nào trả lời đúng đề?
items.explanation_en: A summarises the position and actions; B is an unrelated anecdote.
items.explanation_vi: A tổng kết ý và giải pháp; B kể chuyện không liên quan.

items.question_en: Topic: “Should governments protect endangered animals?” A “Yes. Schools are very beautiful.” B “In summary, public protection is necessary because species loss can damage ecosystems.”
items.question_vi: Chọn kết luận logic.
items.explanation_en: It restates the stance with a reason already suitable for the essay.
items.explanation_vi: B có lập trường cùng lý do phù hợp.

items.question_en: Correct the overclaim: “All pollution will disappear next year.”
items.question_vi: Sửa câu khẳng định quá mức.
items.answer: Stronger environmental policies could reduce pollution over time.
items.explanation_en: Uses could and over time to avoid an unjustified prediction.
items.explanation_vi: Dùng could và over time để dự đoán có chừng mực.

items.question_en: Write a two-sentence conclusion on reducing plastic waste.
items.question_vi: Viết kết luận hai câu về giảm rác nhựa.
items.answer: In conclusion, plastic waste harms wildlife and local environments. Greater recycling and fewer single-use products could help reduce this problem.
items.explanation_en: Summarises the issue and a relevant response.
items.explanation_vi: Nhắc vấn đề và giải pháp, không thêm ý mới.

activities.title: Linkers: function and meaning
activities.instruction_en: Match linking expressions to their functions.
activities.instruction_vi: Ghép từ nối với chức năng.

items.question_en: “On the other hand” introduces: a contrast / an example / a conclusion.
items.question_vi: On the other hand có tác dụng gì?
items.explanation_en: It signals the alternative or opposing view.
items.explanation_vi: Dùng để giới thiệu góc nhìn đối lập.

items.question_en: “For instance” introduces: a reason / an example / a result.
items.question_vi: For instance có tác dụng gì?
items.explanation_en: It makes an idea concrete.
items.explanation_vi: Dùng nêu ví dụ minh họa.

items.question_en: “Therefore” introduces: a result / a contrasting idea.
items.question_vi: Therefore có tác dụng gì?
items.explanation_en: It follows logically from a preceding cause.
items.explanation_vi: Nêu hệ quả của ý trước.

items.question_en: “Furthermore” introduces: an additional point / a conclusion.
items.question_vi: Furthermore có tác dụng gì?
items.explanation_en: It adds a related argument.
items.explanation_vi: Bổ sung luận điểm liên quan.

items.question_en: “In conclusion” belongs mainly at: opening / body / end.
items.question_vi: In conclusion nên dùng ở đâu?
items.explanation_en: It introduces the final paragraph.
items.explanation_vi: Đánh dấu phần tổng kết cuối bài.

activities.title: Two-part question: causes and actions
activities.instruction_en: Recognise both requirements in a causes-and-solutions essay.
activities.instruction_vi: Xác định đủ hai yêu cầu của đề nguyên nhân và giải pháp.

items.question_en: Essay prompt: “Why are wild animals endangered, and what should governments do?” How many main tasks?
items.question_vi: Đề hỏi nguyên nhân và chính phủ làm gì: có mấy yêu cầu chính?
items.explanation_en: The essay must explain causes AND government actions.
items.explanation_vi: Cần phân tích nguyên nhân VÀ việc chính phủ nên làm.

items.question_en: Which belongs under causes? A habitat destruction B protected areas.
items.question_vi: Ý nào thuộc nguyên nhân?
items.explanation_en: Habitat destruction increases extinction risk.
items.explanation_vi: Phá hủy môi trường sống là nguyên nhân.

items.question_en: Which belongs under solutions? A illegal hunting B stronger law enforcement.
items.question_vi: Ý nào thuộc giải pháp?
items.explanation_en: Law enforcement can reduce illegal hunting.
items.explanation_vi: Thực thi pháp luật giúp hạn chế săn trộm.

items.question_en: Should the introduction promise a causes-and-solutions structure? YES/NO.
items.question_vi: Mở bài có thể nói rõ sẽ phân tích nguyên nhân/giải pháp?
items.explanation_en: A concise outline can help organise a two-part essay.
items.explanation_vi: Nêu định hướng ngắn giúp bài mạch lạc.

items.question_en: Which paragraph plan is balanced: A three causes paragraphs, no solution; B causes paragraph + solutions paragraph.
items.question_vi: Dàn ý nào cân đối?
items.explanation_en: Both parts of the task receive development.
items.explanation_vi: Cả hai vế được triển khai.

activities.title: Build a causes–solutions outline
activities.instruction_en: Connect each environmental cause to a realistic response.
activities.instruction_vi: Nối nguyên nhân môi trường với giải pháp phù hợp.

items.question_en: Cause: trees are cut down. Best action: A restore forests B increase plastic packaging.
items.question_vi: Nguyên nhân phá rừng nên có giải pháp gì?
items.explanation_en: Restoring forests addresses habitat loss directly.
items.explanation_vi: Trồng/phục hồi rừng trực tiếp giảm mất nơi sống.

items.question_en: Cause: illegal hunting. Best action: A improve ranger patrols B reduce school homework.
items.question_vi: Nạn săn bắt trái phép cần làm gì?
items.explanation_en: Ranger patrols support enforcement and animal protection.
items.explanation_vi: Tăng tuần tra phù hợp đối phó săn trộm.

items.question_en: Cause: heavy fossil fuel use. Best action: A support clean transport B burn more coal.
items.question_vi: Dùng nhiên liệu hóa thạch nhiều cần giải pháp nào?
items.explanation_en: Cleaner transport may reduce emissions.
items.explanation_vi: Giao thông sạch góp phần giảm khí thải.

items.question_en: Write a topic sentence for the causes paragraph.
items.question_vi: Viết câu chủ đề cho đoạn nguyên nhân.
items.answer: Two major causes of wildlife decline are habitat destruction and illegal hunting.
items.explanation_en: Names the scope of the paragraph clearly.
items.explanation_vi: Giới thiệu đúng hai nguyên nhân sẽ phân tích.

items.question_en: Write a topic sentence for the solutions paragraph.
items.question_vi: Viết câu chủ đề cho đoạn giải pháp.
items.answer: Governments can respond by strengthening environmental laws and expanding protected areas.
items.explanation_en: A clear solutions sentence matches the second task.
items.explanation_vi: Câu định hướng giải pháp bám vế 2 của đề.

activities.title: Present perfect and past simple
activities.instruction_en: Select the tense by time reference and present relevance.
activities.instruction_vi: Chọn hiện tại hoàn thành hoặc quá khứ đơn.

items.question_en: “Over recent decades, people ____ (damage) many forests.”
items.question_vi: Điền thì thích hợp: trong những thập kỷ gần đây.
items.explanation_en: Over recent decades connects past actions with the present.
items.explanation_vi: Mốc kéo dài đến hiện tại → hiện tại hoàn thành.

items.question_en: “In 2019, a storm ____ (destroy) the bridge.”
items.question_vi: Điền thì với mốc 2019.
items.explanation_en: 2019 is a finished time, so past simple is used.
items.explanation_vi: Mốc 2019 đã kết thúc → quá khứ đơn.

items.question_en: “The government ____ (create) a reserve last year.”
items.question_vi: Điền thì với last year.
items.explanation_en: Last year is a completed past period.
items.explanation_vi: Last year chỉ khoảng thời gian quá khứ đã kết thúc.

items.question_en: “Several species ____ (become) less common in recent years.”
items.question_vi: Điền thì với in recent years.
items.explanation_en: Changes continue to matter now.
items.explanation_vi: Sự thay đổi còn liên quan đến hiện tại.

items.question_en: Correct: “People have cut down many trees in 2005.”
items.question_vi: Sửa lỗi thì với năm 2005.
items.answer: People cut down many trees in 2005.
items.explanation_en: A specific finished year takes past simple.
items.explanation_vi: Năm xác định trong quá khứ → dùng quá khứ đơn.

activities.title: Task 2 full outline practice
activities.instruction_en: Plan a complete response to an original environmental essay question.
activities.instruction_vi: Lập dàn ý hoàn chỉnh cho đề môi trường tự biên soạn.

items.question_en: Essay prompt: “What causes increasing waste in cities, and what can be done to reduce it?” Write a one-sentence introduction.
items.question_vi: Mở bài 1 câu cho vấn đề rác thải đô thị.
items.answer: Urban waste is rising for several reasons, but households and governments can take practical steps to reduce it.
items.explanation_en: Paraphrases the topic and covers both tasks.
items.explanation_vi: Diễn đạt lại vấn đề và nêu hai vế.

items.question_en: Name TWO causes and a specific explanation for each.
items.question_vi: Nêu 2 nguyên nhân và giải thích cụ thể.
items.answer: Cause 1: single-use packaging from convenience foods. Cause 2: weak waste-sorting systems, which leave recyclable material mixed with general rubbish.
items.explanation_en: Explains why each cause increases waste.
items.explanation_vi: Mỗi nguyên nhân cần có cơ chế làm rác tăng.

items.question_en: Give TWO linked solutions.
items.question_vi: Nêu 2 giải pháp nối trực tiếp nguyên nhân.
items.answer: Require shops to reduce unnecessary packaging and provide clearly labelled recycling bins with public education.
items.explanation_en: Solutions correspond to the two causes.
items.explanation_vi: Giải pháp xử lý trực tiếp nguyên nhân.

items.question_en: Write a brief conclusion with no new ideas.
items.question_vi: Viết kết luận ngắn, không thêm ý mới.
items.answer: In conclusion, excessive packaging and poor waste management are key causes of urban waste, and targeted business rules together with better recycling services could reduce the problem.
items.explanation_en: Summarises developed points.
items.explanation_vi: Tổng kết nguyên nhân và giải pháp đã trình bày.

activities.title: IELTS-style final essay self-check
activities.instruction_en: Check the requirements before submitting a 250+ word essay.
activities.instruction_vi: Tự đánh giá bài luận 250+ từ trước khi nộp.

items.question_en: A 230-word answer satisfies the instruction “at least 250 words”. TRUE/FALSE.
items.question_vi: 230 từ có đủ ít nhất 250 từ?
items.explanation_en: The stated minimum is 250 words.
items.explanation_vi: 250 là mức tối thiểu.

items.question_en: What must the writer do with both parts of a two-part question?
items.question_vi: Cần làm gì với hai vế đề?
items.explanation_en: Ignoring one part harms task response.
items.explanation_vi: Bỏ một vế ảnh hưởng mức độ đáp ứng đề.

items.question_en: What belongs after a topic sentence? A explanation/evidence B unrelated fun fact.
items.question_vi: Sau câu chủ đề là gì?
items.explanation_en: Development supports the argument.
items.explanation_vi: Cần giải thích và minh chứng.

items.question_en: A conclusion introduces a brand-new main solution. Acceptable? YES/NO.
items.question_vi: Kết luận thêm giải pháp hoàn toàn mới có phù hợp?
items.explanation_en: Conclusions should synthesise, not expand into new arguments.
items.explanation_vi: Kết luận tổng hợp ý cũ, không mở luận điểm mới.

items.question_en: Write a 250+ word essay on this prompt: “Air pollution is increasing in many cities. What are the causes, and what solutions can be taken?”
items.question_vi: Viết bài 250+ từ: ô nhiễm không khí đô thị, nguyên nhân và giải pháp.
items.answer: See the complete teacher model “Urban Air Pollution: Causes and Responses”; students may use different relevant examples.
items.explanation_en: Open writing must be judged by task, coherence, vocabulary and grammar, not exact wording.
items.explanation_vi: Bài mở chấm theo đáp ứng đề, mạch lạc, từ vựng và ngữ pháp; không bắt buộc giống bài mẫu.

activities.title: Animal names and identifying features
activities.instruction_en: Listen to Track A and answer about four animal species.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe Track A và xác định bốn loài động vật.

items.question_en: Which animal lives in high-altitude forests?
items.question_vi: Loài nào sống trong rừng núi cao?
items.explanation_en: The presenter states that the mountain gorilla lives in forests at high altitude.
items.explanation_vi: Bài nghe nói mountain gorilla sống ở rừng vùng cao.

items.question_en: Which animal has bright blue rings?
items.question_vi: Loài nào có các vòng màu xanh sáng?
items.explanation_en: Bright blue rings are the distinctive identification clue.
items.explanation_vi: Vòng xanh sáng là đặc điểm nhận dạng.

items.question_en: Which animal hunts mostly at night?
items.question_vi: Loài nào thường săn mồi ban đêm?
items.explanation_en: It hunts smaller animals especially at night.
items.explanation_vi: Từ khóa especially at night là bằng chứng.

items.question_en: Which animal is known for unusual antlers?
items.question_vi: Loài nào nổi bật vì bộ gạc?
items.explanation_en: The last description names its unusual antlers.
items.explanation_vi: Mô tả cuối nhắc bộ gạc khác thường.

items.question_en: The octopus is safe to touch because it is small. TRUE/FALSE.
items.question_vi: Bạch tuộc nhỏ nên an toàn khi chạm.
items.explanation_en: The presenter explicitly says people should never touch it.
items.explanation_vi: Bài nghe nhấn mạnh không chạm vào.

activities.title: Note headings: predict information type
activities.instruction_en: Classify notes under Origin, Habitat, Appearance, Diet or Dangers.
activities.instruction_vi: Phân loại ghi chú theo nguồn gốc, nơi sống, ngoại hình, thức ăn và nguy cơ.

items.question_en: “central Africa” belongs to which heading?
items.question_vi: Central Africa thuộc mục nào?
items.explanation_en: It identifies geographic origin.
items.explanation_vi: Chỉ nguồn gốc địa lý.

items.question_en: “thick coat of fur” belongs to which heading?
items.question_vi: Thick coat of fur thuộc mục nào?
items.explanation_en: A fur coat is a physical feature.
items.explanation_vi: Lớp lông dày là đặc điểm ngoại hình.

items.question_en: “eats leaves and stems” belongs to which heading?
items.question_vi: Eats leaves and stems thuộc mục nào?
items.explanation_en: Describes food eaten by the species.
items.explanation_vi: Nêu thức ăn của loài.

items.question_en: “forest loss” belongs to which heading?
items.question_vi: Forest loss thuộc mục nào?
items.explanation_en: Habitat destruction is a threat.
items.explanation_vi: Mất rừng là mối nguy.

items.question_en: “builds a nest on the ground” belongs to which heading?
items.question_vi: Làm tổ dưới đất thuộc mục nào?
items.explanation_en: Describes a place where the animal rests.
items.explanation_vi: Mô tả nơi ở/nghỉ của động vật.

activities.title: Signposting words
activities.instruction_en: Connect signposting phrases to presentation functions.
activities.instruction_vi: Nối từ báo hiệu với chức năng trong bài nghe.

items.question_en: “First, let us examine...” signals: beginning / conclusion.
items.question_vi: First, let us examine báo hiệu gì?
items.explanation_en: First introduces the initial point.
items.explanation_vi: First mở ý đầu.

items.question_en: “Next, we will discuss...” signals: a new point / a correction.
items.question_vi: Next, we will discuss báo hiệu gì?
items.explanation_en: Next moves to the following topic.
items.explanation_vi: Next chuyển sang ý tiếp.

items.question_en: “In other words...” signals: restatement / an example.
items.question_vi: In other words báo hiệu gì?
items.explanation_en: It rephrases an idea in simpler wording.
items.explanation_vi: Diễn đạt lại cùng ý.

items.question_en: “Finally...” signals: a last point / earlier disagreement.
items.question_vi: Finally báo hiệu gì?
items.explanation_en: It introduces the final section.
items.explanation_vi: Giới thiệu ý cuối.

items.question_en: “There are two main reasons...” predicts how many parts?
items.question_vi: There are two main reasons: dự báo mấy ý?
items.explanation_en: The number two predicts two reasons will follow.
items.explanation_vi: Two báo hiệu hai lý do.

activities.title: Gorilla note completion
activities.instruction_en: Listen to Track B. Use NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS per answer.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe Track B, điền KHÔNG QUÁ HAI TỪ.

items.question_en: Gorillas build a night nest on the ______.
items.question_vi: Gorilla làm tổ ban đêm trên ____.
items.explanation_en: The recording says “builds a nest on the ground”.
items.explanation_vi: Có đúng cụm on the ground trong bài.

items.question_en: Older males have a ______-coloured back.
items.question_vi: Con đực lớn tuổi có lưng màu ____.
items.explanation_en: The lecturer says silver-coloured back.
items.explanation_vi: Dạng ghi chú đã có -coloured, chỉ điền silver.

items.question_en: Older males are called ______.
items.question_vi: Con đực lớn tuổi gọi là gì?
items.explanation_en: The term is given explicitly after “which is why”.
items.explanation_vi: Thuật ngữ có sau which is why.

items.question_en: Plants supply most of their ______.
items.question_vi: Thực vật cung cấp phần lớn _____.
items.explanation_en: Plants supply most of the energy they need.
items.explanation_vi: Bằng chứng trực tiếp ở phần diet.

items.question_en: Besides forest loss, ______ can be dangerous.
items.question_vi: Ngoài mất rừng, nguy cơ nào khác?
items.explanation_en: The lecturer names disease as another danger.
items.explanation_vi: Bài nói disease là mối nguy thứ hai.

activities.title: Gorilla distractors and forms
activities.instruction_en: Use Track B to decide why the incorrect alternatives fail.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe Track B để giải thích vì sao phương án nhiễu sai.

items.question_en: Nest: “only in trees” / “on the ground”. Choose the correct location.
items.question_vi: Tổ: chỉ trên cây hay trên mặt đất?
items.explanation_en: Trees are mentioned for younger gorillas sometimes, not the main night-nest statement.
items.explanation_vi: Trees là thông tin phụ nói về gorilla nhỏ; chỗ chính là ground.

items.question_en: “silverbacks” is singular or plural in “Older males are called ...”?
items.question_vi: Silverbacks trong câu là số ít hay số nhiều?
items.explanation_en: “Older males” requires a plural class name.
items.explanation_vi: Older males là chủ ngữ số nhiều.

items.question_en: Which word completes “a thick dark ____”?
items.question_vi: Điền a thick dark ____.
items.explanation_en: The transcript uses “a thick dark coat”.
items.explanation_vi: Bài nói rõ coat.

items.question_en: Do the workers ENCOURAGE close contact? YES/NO.
items.question_vi: Nhân viên khuyến khích tiếp xúc gần?
items.explanation_en: They limit close contact to manage disease risk.
items.explanation_vi: Bài ghi limit close contact, tức hạn chế.

activities.title: Bullfrog note completion
activities.instruction_en: Listen to Track C; write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER per answer.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe Track C, điền KHÔNG QUÁ HAI TỪ và/hoặc một số.

items.question_en: Origin: eastern ______.
items.question_vi: Nguồn gốc: miền đông ____.
items.explanation_en: The correct phrase is “eastern North America”; for this practice answer the geographic name.
items.explanation_vi: Địa danh được nêu là North America; bài này cho phép tên riêng 2 từ.

items.question_en: Introduced to Europe during the ______ century.
items.question_vi: Được đưa sang châu Âu trong thế kỷ ____.
items.explanation_en: The transcript explicitly states the twentieth century.
items.explanation_vi: Bài nêu thế kỷ XX; 20th cũng chấp nhận.

items.question_en: Maximum weight of an adult female: ______ grams.
items.question_vi: Khối lượng tối đa con cái trưởng thành: ____ gram.
items.explanation_en: The phrase “up to 700 grams” gives an upper bound.
items.explanation_vi: Up to 700 nghĩa tối đa 700.

items.question_en: The male has a ______ throat.
items.question_vi: Con đực có cổ màu ____.
items.explanation_en: The word before throat is yellow.
items.explanation_vi: Tính từ chỉ màu là yellow.

items.question_en: The frog may spread ______.
items.question_vi: Ếch có thể lây lan gì?
items.explanation_en: Both competition and disease spread are mentioned.
items.explanation_vi: Bài nói có thể lây lan bệnh.

items.question_en: Research budget: about ______ million euros.
items.question_vi: Ngân sách nghiên cứu: khoảng ____ triệu euro.
items.explanation_en: The speaker explicitly says about 2 million euros.
items.explanation_vi: Nghe từ “about 2 million euros”.

activities.title: Jellyfish: scientific notes without panic
activities.instruction_en: Listen to Track D and complete key information.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe Track D và ghi thông tin chính về sứa.

items.question_en: Box jellyfish may occur in ______ coastal waters.
items.question_vi: Sứa hộp sống ở vùng biển ven bờ _____.
items.explanation_en: The opening describes “warm coastal waters”.
items.explanation_vi: Tính từ đứng trước coastal waters là warm.

items.question_en: Its bell is ______-shaped.
items.question_vi: Phần chuông có hình ____.
items.explanation_en: The common name matches its box-shaped bell.
items.explanation_vi: Box-shaped nghĩa hình hộp.

items.question_en: Its tentacles contain ______ cells.
items.question_vi: Xúc tu chứa tế bào ____.
items.explanation_en: The lecturer says “stinging cells”.
items.explanation_vi: Đáp án lấy trực tiếp stinging.

items.question_en: Swimmers should follow local safety ______.
items.question_vi: Người bơi nên tuân theo ____ an toàn.
items.explanation_en: The text advises following local safety notices.
items.explanation_vi: Cụm safety notices = thông báo/cảnh báo an toàn.

items.question_en: If someone is stung, the speaker recommends contacting ______ services or lifeguards.
items.question_vi: Khi bị đốt cần liên hệ dịch vụ ____ hoặc cứu hộ.
items.explanation_en: The audio specifically says emergency services or local lifesavers.
items.explanation_vi: Bài đề cập dịch vụ cấp cứu/cứu hộ. Đây không phải hướng dẫn sơ cứu đầy đủ.

activities.title: Habitat–diet–threats notes
activities.instruction_en: Listen to Track E and distinguish five types of details.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe Track E phân loại thông tin nơi sống – thức ăn – mối nguy.

items.question_en: The reserve includes forests and ______.
items.question_vi: Khu bảo tồn gồm rừng và ____.
items.explanation_en: Grasslands is the second habitat type.
items.explanation_vi: Grasslands là nơi sống thứ hai.

items.question_en: Visitors cannot walk on the river’s ______ bank.
items.question_vi: Khách không được đi dọc bờ ____ của sông.
items.explanation_en: The restricted bank is the northern bank.
items.explanation_vi: Northern là phương hướng nêu trong bài.

items.question_en: Rescued owls eat mainly small ______.
items.question_vi: Cú được cứu ăn chủ yếu ____ nhỏ.
items.explanation_en: Not fruit: “mainly eat small mammals”.
items.explanation_vi: Có bẫy đối lập với fruit, đáp án mammals.

items.question_en: The reserve employs ______ rangers now.
items.question_vi: Khu bảo tồn hiện có ____ kiểm lâm.
items.explanation_en: The original number 12 is corrected to 18 now.
items.explanation_vi: 12 là số cũ, now 18 mới là đáp án.

items.question_en: Visitors should stay on marked ______.
items.question_vi: Khách nên ở trên ____ được đánh dấu.
items.explanation_en: The final advice is to stay on marked paths.
items.explanation_vi: Đáp án paths nằm ở đoạn Lastly.

items.question_en: Can visitors feed wild animals? YES/NO.
items.question_vi: Khách được cho động vật ăn không?
items.explanation_en: The final sentence prohibits feeding.
items.explanation_vi: Câu cuối nói feeding wild animals is not allowed.

activities.title: Recognise chronological corrections
activities.instruction_en: Identify changed information and compare the final figure.
activities.instruction_vi: Nhận diện thông tin cũ và thông tin được sửa.

items.question_en: Track E says 12 rangers before, 18 now. What is the present number?
items.question_vi: 12 kiểm lâm trước đây, 18 hiện tại; đáp án hiện tại?
items.explanation_en: The current figure is introduced with now.
items.explanation_vi: Now đánh dấu số đúng hiện tại.

items.question_en: In Track C, “up to 700 grams” means all females weigh 700 grams. TRUE/FALSE.
items.question_vi: Up to 700 gram có nghĩa tất cả nặng 700 gram?
items.explanation_en: Up to means a maximum, not a typical or exact weight.
items.explanation_vi: Up to là mức tối đa, không phải mọi con đều đúng số đó.

items.question_en: Track D says “some species have dozens of eyes”. Does this prove ALL species have dozens? YES/NO.
items.question_vi: Some species có nghĩa tất cả loài đều như vậy?
items.explanation_en: Some is a limited quantifier.
items.explanation_vi: Some chỉ một số loài.

items.question_en: Track E: “The owls eat fruit.” TRUE/FALSE.
items.question_vi: Cú trong bài ăn trái cây?
items.explanation_en: The presenter says “not fruit” and gives small mammals.
items.explanation_vi: Bài phủ định not fruit, sau đó nói small mammals.

activities.title: Zoo education: notes and paraphrase
activities.instruction_en: Listen to Track F, distinguishing benefit and conditions.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe Track F về lợi ích và điều kiện của sở thú.

items.question_en: A zoo can help ______ learn about unfamiliar species.
items.question_vi: Sở thú giúp ____ tìm hiểu loài lạ.
items.explanation_en: Children is explicitly mentioned as learners.
items.explanation_vi: Bài nêu children.

items.question_en: What must come first, even before education?
items.question_vi: Điều gì phải ưu tiên hơn giáo dục?
items.explanation_en: The educator states “animal welfare must come first”.
items.explanation_vi: Animal welfare được nhấn mạnh là ưu tiên.

items.question_en: Breeding projects require expert ______.
items.question_vi: Dự án nhân giống cần ____ chuyên môn.
items.explanation_en: The speaker says expert support.
items.explanation_vi: Đáp án support.

items.question_en: Children should learn to reduce ______.
items.question_vi: Trẻ cần học giảm ____.
items.explanation_en: Reducing waste is a practical conservation action in the dialogue.
items.explanation_vi: Bài nêu reduce waste.

items.question_en: Do all zoos protect wildlife effectively? YES/NO/NOT STATED.
items.question_vi: Có khẳng định mọi sở thú đều hiệu quả không?
items.explanation_en: The speaker says some accredited zoos take part; it does not evaluate every zoo.
items.explanation_vi: Some accredited zoos không đồng nghĩa tất cả; không đủ thông tin kết luận chung.

activities.title: Animals, features and habitats
activities.instruction_en: Match animal features to species and habitats.
activities.instruction_vi: Ghép đặc điểm, loài và môi trường sống.

items.question_en: Which animal has antlers: eagle / deer / dolphin?
items.question_vi: Loài nào có gạc?
items.explanation_en: Deer are known for antlers; not all individuals have them.
items.explanation_vi: Hươu/nai nổi bật với gạc, dù không phải mọi cá thể đều có.

items.question_en: Which animal has a long trunk: camel / elephant / eagle?
items.question_vi: Loài nào có vòi dài?
items.explanation_en: An elephant has a trunk.
items.explanation_vi: Trunk là vòi voi.

items.question_en: Which animal has a hump: dolphin / camel / deer?
items.question_vi: Loài nào có bướu?
items.explanation_en: Camels have one or two humps depending on species.
items.explanation_vi: Lạc đà có một hoặc hai bướu tùy loài.

items.question_en: Which habitat is most suitable for dolphins: desert / sea / mountains?
items.question_vi: Cá heo sống nơi nào?
items.explanation_en: Dolphins are aquatic mammals.
items.explanation_vi: Cá heo là động vật có vú sống dưới nước.

items.question_en: Which body part helps a bird fly: wing / antler / hoof?
items.question_vi: Bộ phận giúp chim bay?
items.explanation_en: Wings are the relevant body structures for flight.
items.explanation_vi: Wing là cánh.

items.question_en: Which word means the food an animal normally eats? diet / habitat / origin.
items.question_vi: Từ nào chỉ thức ăn động vật thường ăn?
items.explanation_en: Diet describes food consumption.
items.explanation_vi: Diet là chế độ ăn.

activities.title: Build a descriptive sentence
activities.instruction_en: Turn animal facts into natural spoken sentences.
activities.instruction_vi: Biến thông tin về động vật thành câu nói tự nhiên.

items.question_en: Describe a deer using “antlers” and “forest”.
items.question_vi: Mô tả nai/hươu với antlers và forest.
items.answer: A deer often lives in woodland, and some males have large antlers.
items.explanation_en: Include a feature and habitat without claiming every deer has antlers.
items.explanation_vi: Có đặc điểm và môi trường sống, tránh tuyệt đối hóa.

items.question_en: Describe an eagle using “sharp claws”.
items.question_vi: Mô tả đại bàng với sharp claws.
items.answer: An eagle is a powerful bird with sharp claws that help it catch prey.
items.explanation_en: Explains the function of the feature.
items.explanation_vi: Không chỉ liệt kê mà còn giải thích công dụng.

items.question_en: Describe a dolphin using “intelligent” and “ocean”.
items.question_vi: Mô tả cá heo với intelligent và ocean.
items.answer: Dolphins are intelligent mammals that live in the ocean and communicate through different sounds.
items.explanation_en: Adds a natural, relevant fact.
items.explanation_vi: Thêm thông tin hợp ngữ cảnh.

items.question_en: Correct the grammar: “It live in the jungle.”
items.question_vi: Sửa lỗi chia động từ.
items.explanation_en: It takes third-person -s in present simple.
items.explanation_vi: It ở hiện tại đơn phải thêm -s.

items.question_en: Which adjective describes a dangerous animal naturally: endangered / venomous / renewable?
items.question_vi: Tính từ nào mô tả động vật có nọc độc?
items.explanation_en: Venomous means able to inject venom; endangered refers to extinction risk.
items.explanation_vi: Venomous là có nọc độc, endangered là nguy cấp.

activities.title: Part 2 cue-card breakdown
activities.instruction_en: Analyse a wildlife Part 2 card before preparing notes.
activities.instruction_vi: Phân tích thẻ Speaking Part 2 chủ đề động vật hoang dã.

items.question_en: Card asks: “what it looks like”. Which category? food / appearance / feelings.
items.question_vi: What it looks like hỏi gì?
items.explanation_en: Appearance describes physical characteristics.
items.explanation_vi: Hỏi ngoại hình.

items.question_en: Card asks: “what it eats”. Which category? diet / habitat / protection.
items.question_vi: What it eats hỏi gì?
items.explanation_en: This prompt asks for the animal’s food.
items.explanation_vi: Hỏi thức ăn.

items.question_en: Card asks: “where it lives”. Which category? habitat / emotion / cost.
items.question_vi: Where it lives hỏi gì?
items.explanation_en: Habitat is the living environment.
items.explanation_vi: Hỏi môi trường sống.

items.question_en: Card asks: “how people feel about it”. Which category? social opinion / physical feature.
items.question_vi: How people feel hỏi gì?
items.explanation_en: You need to describe public reactions or attitudes.
items.explanation_vi: Nói cảm nhận, thái độ của mọi người.

items.question_en: During the preparation minute, should you write a full 2-minute script? YES/NO.
items.question_vi: Một phút chuẩn bị có nên viết nguyên bài?
items.explanation_en: Keywords and short phrases are faster and easier to use.
items.explanation_vi: Chỉ ghi từ khóa; không đủ thời gian chép bài hoàn chỉnh.

activities.title: Part 2: original note plan
activities.instruction_en: Make original bullet notes for an Asian elephant talk.
activities.instruction_vi: Lập dàn ý nói về voi châu Á.

items.question_en: Give 3 keywords describing appearance.
items.question_vi: Nêu 3 từ/cụm từ ngoại hình.
items.answer: large ears; a long trunk; thick grey skin
items.explanation_en: Choose recognisable features and form phrases, not an essay.
items.explanation_vi: Chọn đặc điểm dễ nhận diện, ghi dạng cụm từ.

items.question_en: Give 2 keywords for habitat.
items.question_vi: Nêu 2 từ về nơi sống.
items.explanation_en: The habitat should match the species.
items.explanation_vi: Nơi sống cần đúng với loài.

items.question_en: Give 2 keywords for diet.
items.question_vi: Nêu 2 từ về thức ăn.
items.explanation_en: Elephants are herbivores; no meat.
items.explanation_vi: Voi ăn thực vật.

items.question_en: Write an opening sentence for a talk on the Asian elephant.
items.question_vi: Viết câu mở đầu Part 2.
items.answer: I’d like to talk about the Asian elephant, one of the most impressive wild animals found in parts of Asia.
items.explanation_en: Identifies the subject naturally.
items.explanation_vi: Câu mở giới thiệu rõ con vật.

items.question_en: Give a final feeling/opinion sentence.
items.question_vi: Viết câu kết thể hiện cảm nghĩ.
items.answer: I admire elephants because they are intelligent animals, and I believe their habitats should be protected.
items.explanation_en: Directly answers the final cue point and adds a reason.
items.explanation_vi: Trả lời cảm nhận kèm lý do.

activities.title: Part 2: develop a two-minute talk
activities.instruction_en: Use notes to elaborate with examples rather than repeat a keyword list.
activities.instruction_vi: Từ dàn ý triển khai lời nói, không chỉ liệt kê từ.

items.question_en: Expand “long trunk” into one sentence with function.
items.question_vi: Mở rộng long trunk thành câu có công dụng.
items.answer: Its long trunk helps it pick up food, drink water and explore its surroundings.
items.explanation_en: Adds meaningful functional detail.
items.explanation_vi: Có ví dụ công dụng nên câu giàu thông tin.

items.question_en: Expand “forest” into two sentences about habitat and threat.
items.question_vi: Mở rộng forest thành hai câu.
items.answer: Asian elephants often live in forested areas. Sadly, some populations face habitat loss when forests are cleared.
items.explanation_en: A fact and a relevant challenge create cohesion.
items.explanation_vi: Nối nơi sống với nguy cơ mất môi trường.

items.question_en: Give a transition from appearance to diet.
items.question_vi: Chuyển từ ngoại hình sang thức ăn.
items.answer: As for its diet, the elephant mainly eats plants such as grass and leaves.
items.explanation_en: As for marks a new cue point naturally.
items.explanation_vi: As for giúp chuyển ý mềm mại.

items.question_en: Is a personal opinion required for the last cue point? YES/NO.
items.question_vi: Có phải nói cảm nghĩ ở ý cuối?
items.explanation_en: The card asks you to explain how people feel about the animal.
items.explanation_vi: Thẻ yêu cầu cảm nghĩ, không thể bỏ.

activities.title: Speaking Part 3: direct answers
activities.instruction_en: Choose which sentence answers the examiner’s question directly.
activities.instruction_vi: Chọn câu trả lời đúng trọng tâm câu hỏi Part 3.

items.question_en: “What can governments do to stop illegal hunting?” A “They could enforce anti-poaching laws.” B “Elephants have trunks.”
items.question_vi: Câu trả lời đúng hỏi ngăn săn trái phép?
items.explanation_en: It gives a government action rather than an animal fact.
items.explanation_vi: A nêu hành động chính phủ có thể làm.

items.question_en: “Should governments fund zoos?” A “It depends on standards and conservation outcomes.” B “Zoos are buildings.”
items.question_vi: Câu trả lời bám đề về cấp ngân sách?
items.explanation_en: It expresses a reasoned position with conditions.
items.explanation_vi: A thể hiện ý kiến có điều kiện.

items.question_en: “Will wildlife be safer in the future?” A “Perhaps, if habitats are protected.” B “I went to a park.”
items.question_vi: Câu nào dự đoán tương lai?
items.explanation_en: Perhaps and if signal a cautious prediction.
items.explanation_vi: Perhaps và if thể hiện dự đoán có điều kiện.

items.question_en: “How did children learn about wildlife in the past?” A “Mostly from books and visits.” B “All animals are pets.”
items.question_vi: Câu nào so sánh quá khứ?
items.explanation_en: A identifies past learning channels.
items.explanation_vi: A đề cập cách học trong quá khứ.

activities.title: Part 3: answer–reason–example
activities.instruction_en: Produce a direct answer, reason and relevant example.
activities.instruction_vi: Trả lời trực tiếp – lý do – ví dụ.

items.question_en: What should governments do to prevent illegal hunting?
items.question_vi: Chính phủ cần làm gì để ngăn săn bắt trái phép?
items.answer: Governments should increase patrols and punish illegal hunting. This could discourage offenders. For example, trained rangers could monitor high-risk forest areas.
items.explanation_en: Answer + why + example, all tied to prevention.
items.explanation_vi: Có đề xuất, tác dụng và ví dụ đúng chủ đề.

items.question_en: Should the government provide more money for zoos?
items.question_vi: Có nên tăng ngân sách cho sở thú?
items.answer: I think it depends on how the money is used. Well-managed zoos may need funds for veterinary care and conservation projects, but facilities with poor welfare standards should be improved first.
items.explanation_en: Balanced answer with criteria, not a yes/no only.
items.explanation_vi: Quan điểm cân bằng, có tiêu chí phúc lợi động vật.

items.question_en: How might people protect wildlife in the future?
items.question_vi: Tương lai con người có thể bảo vệ động vật ra sao?
items.answer: Technology may help rangers monitor habitats more effectively. For instance, cameras can detect suspicious activity in protected areas.
items.explanation_en: A plausible prediction followed by concrete example.
items.explanation_vi: Dự đoán hợp lý kèm ví dụ camera giám sát.

items.question_en: How has wildlife education changed?
items.question_vi: Giáo dục về động vật đã thay đổi ra sao?
items.answer: In the past, children mainly learned from textbooks and documentaries. Today they can also use interactive websites and virtual tours, although the quality of information varies.
items.explanation_en: Compares periods without overgeneralising.
items.explanation_vi: So sánh quá khứ với hiện tại có lưu ý chất lượng nguồn.

activities.title: Pets: pros, cons and responsibility
activities.instruction_en: Develop nuanced ideas about keeping animals as pets.
activities.instruction_vi: Phát triển ý hai mặt của việc nuôi thú cưng.

items.question_en: Which is a benefit: companionship / neglect / habitat destruction?
items.question_vi: Lợi ích nuôi thú cưng?
items.explanation_en: Companionship is an emotional benefit.
items.explanation_vi: Companionship là sự bầu bạn.

items.question_en: Which is a responsibility: veterinary care / ignoring illness?
items.question_vi: Trách nhiệm nuôi thú cưng?
items.explanation_en: Responsible owners provide health care.
items.explanation_vi: Người nuôi có trách nhiệm chăm sóc y tế.

items.question_en: Should a dangerous wild animal automatically be treated like a domestic pet? YES/NO.
items.question_vi: Có nên coi thú hoang nguy hiểm như thú nuôi?
items.explanation_en: Wild species may have complex needs and safety risks.
items.explanation_vi: Loài hoang dã có nhu cầu chuyên biệt và rủi ro an toàn.

items.question_en: How can children learn from taking care of pets?
items.question_vi: Trẻ học được gì khi chăm thú cưng?
items.answer: They can learn responsibility by feeding an animal on time and treating it gently. However, an adult must still supervise care.
items.explanation_en: Gives a practical behaviour and an important qualification.

A.title: Four animals: introduction
dialogue: Today four students will present animals from different environments. First, the mountain gorilla lives in forests at high altitude and mainly eats leaves and other plants.
Second, the blue-ringed octopus is small and lives in coastal water. Its bright blue rings are a warning, and people should never touch it.
Third, the Arabian leopard is a rare wild cat adapted to dry mountains. It hunts smaller animals, especially at night.
Finally, Père David’s deer originally lived in China and is known for its unusual antlers. Conservation programmes have helped protect this species.

B.title: Mountain gorilla research notes
dialogue: Let us begin with the mountain gorilla. This animal is found in the forests of central Africa, often at high elevations.
First, its habitat. At night it builds a nest on the ground, although younger gorillas may sometimes use trees.
As for appearance, an adult male has a thick dark coat. Older males often develop a silver-coloured back, which is why they are called silverbacks.
Next, diet. Mountain gorillas eat leaves, stems and some fruit. Plants supply most of the energy they need.
Finally, the dangers. Forest loss is a serious threat. Disease can also be dangerous, so park workers limit close contact between visitors and gorillas.

C.title: The American bullfrog
dialogue: The American bullfrog is native to eastern North America. It was introduced to some European countries during the twentieth century.
Let us look at its physical features. An adult female can weigh up to 700 grams, although most weigh less. The frog has a broad body and strong back legs.
The male has a yellow throat. Both males and females have a large mouth.
Why can the bullfrog cause problems? It eats insects, fish and smaller frogs, and can compete with local species for food. Bullfrogs can also spread diseases.
Researchers have spent about 2 million euros studying the problem in several regions. Notice that this is a research budget, not a number of animals.

D.title: Sea creatures and safety awareness
dialogue: This programme is about a marine animal called the box jellyfish. It is found in warm coastal waters, including areas near northern Australia.
A box jellyfish has a box-shaped bell and long tentacles. Some species have dozens of eyes. Its body can appear almost transparent in the water.
The tentacles contain stinging cells that can inject venom. Encounters with some species are dangerous and require immediate professional medical assistance.
For this reason, swimmers should follow local safety notices and avoid entering areas where dangerous jellyfish have been reported.
This audio describes an animal; it is not a first-aid lesson. If somebody is stung, contact emergency services or local lifesavers and follow current professional advice.

E.title: Wildlife conservation project briefing
dialogue: Good morning. Our nature reserve protects several endangered species. I will cover four points: habitat, food, current threats and what visitors can do.
First, habitat. The reserve includes forests and grasslands. The river is important, but we do not allow visitors to walk along its northern bank.
Second, food. Most of the deer eat leaves and grass. However, the rescued owls mainly eat small mammals, not fruit.
Third, threats. Illegal hunting is a major problem, and plastic waste can injure animals. The reserve used to have 12 rangers, but now employs 18.
Lastly, visitors can help by staying on marked paths, taking rubbish home and reporting suspicious behaviour to staff. Please remember that feeding wild animals is not allowed.

F.title: Notes on zoo education
dialogue: What is the main benefit of a well-managed zoo?
It can teach children about animals they would rarely see in person. However, education alone is not enough; animal welfare must come first.
Some accredited zoos take part in carefully managed breeding projects, but those projects need suitable habitats and expert support.
What should children learn during a visit?
They should learn why wild animals need space, what threatens their habitats and how they can reduce waste. We encourage them to support conservation rather than treat animals as entertainment.

writing_models.title: Urban Air Pollution: Causes and Responses
writing_models.question: Air pollution is becoming more serious in many cities. What are its main causes, and what can governments and individuals do to reduce it?
writing_models.text:
Air pollution is a serious challenge for many growing cities. Although it is caused by several everyday activities, both public authorities and local residents can take practical steps to improve the situation. This essay will examine the main causes of urban air pollution and suggest possible solutions.

One major cause is the increasing number of private vehicles on the roads. When large numbers of cars and motorbikes use petrol or diesel, they produce emissions that can reduce air quality. Traffic congestion makes this problem worse because engines often remain running while vehicles move slowly. Another factor is energy use in industry and buildings. Some factories and power stations continue to depend on fossil fuels, while poorly maintained equipment can waste energy and produce additional pollution.

There are several ways to respond to these problems. First, governments should invest in reliable public transport and safer routes for cyclists and pedestrians. If buses and trains are convenient and affordable, more commuters may choose them instead of driving. Authorities should also set clear emissions standards for factories and inspect whether businesses follow the rules. At the same time, individuals can help by sharing journeys, saving electricity and avoiding unnecessary car trips. For example, a family might use public transport for short journeys and switch off unused electrical devices at home.

In conclusion, heavy road traffic and dependence on fossil fuels are important causes of urban air pollution. Better transport, effective industrial regulations and responsible daily choices could gradually make city air cleaner. A combination of government action and public participation is likely to be more effective than either approach alone.

writing_models.title: Endangered Wildlife: Reasons and Government Action
writing_models.question: Many wild animals are at risk of extinction. Why has this happened, and what should governments do to protect them?
writing_models.text:
Many wildlife species now face a growing risk of extinction. The problem has several causes, most of which are linked to human activity. In my view, governments need to address both the destruction of natural habitats and illegal hunting if they want to protect wildlife effectively.

The first major cause is habitat loss. Forests, wetlands and grasslands are sometimes cleared for roads, farms or new buildings. As a result, animals may lose places to feed, rest and raise their young. Some species also find it difficult to move safely between small areas of natural habitat. A second serious cause is illegal hunting. Wild animals can be caught for meat or valuable body parts, and weak enforcement allows this activity to continue in certain regions. These pressures may be particularly harmful when an animal population is already small.

Governments can take several practical measures. One important step is to create and maintain protected areas that contain suitable habitats and safe routes for animal movement. Such areas need properly trained rangers, clear rules and long-term funding rather than signs alone. Authorities should also punish illegal hunting and cooperate with local communities to provide alternative sources of income. For instance, conservation projects could employ local residents as guides or forest monitors. Finally, schools and public media can explain why biodiversity matters and how people can avoid buying products made from threatened animals.

To conclude, habitat destruction and illegal hunting are two key reasons why wildlife is declining. Stronger protection, better law enforcement and community education could reduce these threats. Long-term success will depend on both government commitment and cooperation from people living near wildlife habitats.

speaking_models.title: Part 2: A wild animal in my country - the Asian elephant
speaking_models.cue: Describe a wild animal from your country. Say what it looks like, where it lives, what it eats and how people feel about it.
speaking_models.text:
I’d like to talk about the Asian elephant, which is one of the most impressive wild animals found in parts of my region. I first learned about it when I watched a documentary at school, and I have been interested in this animal ever since.

In terms of appearance, an elephant is enormous. It has thick grey skin, large ears and, most importantly, a long and flexible trunk. It can use its trunk to pick up food and drink water. Some elephants also have tusks, although not every individual has them.

As for its habitat, this animal can live in forested areas and grasslands. It needs access to food, water and enough space to move around. Elephants mainly eat plants, including grass, leaves and fruit, so they spend a great deal of time looking for food.

I think many people admire elephants because they seem intelligent and social. However, some communities may also worry when elephants come close to farms, especially if their natural habitats have been reduced. Personally, I find them fascinating, and I believe protecting their habitats is important. I would love to see one from a safe distance in a well-managed wildlife reserve one day.

speaking_models.cue: Give opinions, explanations and examples on illegal hunting, pets, zoo education and conservation.
speaking_models.text:
Question: What should governments do to prevent illegal hunting?
Answer: I think governments need stronger enforcement and better protection in high-risk areas. Trained rangers could monitor reserves, while clear penalties might discourage illegal hunting. They should also involve nearby communities because local people can help report suspicious activities.

Question: What can children learn from looking after pets?
Answer: They can learn patience and responsibility. For instance, feeding a pet at regular times teaches children that an animal depends on daily care. Parents should supervise this process to make sure the pet is treated well.

Question: Do you think zoos will be important in the future?
Answer: Some zoos may still play an important role in education and conservation. However, this will depend on animal welfare and the quality of their programmes. I expect poorly managed zoos to face increasing public criticism.

A.title: When Ocean Animals Come Close
A.subtitle_vi: Khi động vật biển tiến lại gần
A.note: Original fictional learning scenarios; not scientific claims about specific rescues.

paragraphs.text: Dolphins and whales are intelligent marine mammals. They breathe air, live in social groups and communicate using a range of sounds. Many people describe stories in which these animals appear to assist humans or other sea creatures. Scientists are interested in these accounts, but they cannot always tell whether an animal intended to help. A dolphin may simply be curious, and a whale might be responding to an unfamiliar sound.

During a coastal training exercise, volunteer cameraman Daniel was filming a pod of six dolphins from a research boat. He noticed that the animals were swimming repeatedly around the same small area. A few minutes later, the crew spotted a tired swimmer holding on to a floating board. The crew brought the swimmer safely on board. Daniel posted his video online, but he explained that the film did not prove the dolphins had understood the danger.

Another account comes from a diving instructor named Priya. While practising near a reef, she lost sight of her boat because the water became cloudy. She could still hear the engine, but she could not see the rope used to climb back into the boat. Two dolphins passed her several times. Their movements attracted the attention of a crew member, who then found Priya and threw her a safety line. Priya was grateful, although she admitted that the animals might have been looking for fish.

At a wildlife rescue centre, staff study how young seals respond to sound. Some animals can learn to follow a simple signal, but they cannot understand long instructions like humans. A researcher once observed a seal remaining close to a weaker animal until it reached shallow water. This behaviour might indicate social bonding. However, one observation is not enough to establish a rule about every seal.

Large whales can also attract attention to animals in trouble. In a fictional class case, two humpback whales remained beside an injured young whale during a slow journey through a bay. A research team watched from a safe distance and contacted a marine rescue service. The service advised boats to stay away so the whales could move freely. The young whale eventually reached deeper water, but no one knew exactly why the other whales stayed nearby.

These examples remind us that protecting the ocean is more important than treating wild animals as performers. Fishing nets, plastic waste and noisy boats can make survival difficult. People can reduce these risks by keeping beaches clean and following wildlife-viewing rules. Wild animals may behave in ways that surprise us, but they should always be given enough space to live naturally.

B.title: The Changing Role of Wildlife Centres
B.subtitle_vi: Vai trò đang thay đổi của các trung tâm bảo tồn động vật
B.note: Original educational article, fictional institutions and programmes.

paragraphs.text: In the past, many animal parks were built mainly for entertainment. Visitors came to see unusual creatures, and little attention was paid to their natural habitats. Some modern wildlife centres have a different goal: they aim to protect threatened species and explain why animals need safe environments. Nevertheless, not every centre has the same standards, so visitors should ask how animal welfare is checked.

One conservation centre, Riverbank Park, runs a breeding programme for a rare tree frog. When researchers began the programme, only twelve adult frogs were in its care. After three years, the team had raised forty young frogs. Several were transferred to a protected forest after experts decided that the conditions were suitable. The programme is small, but it shows how careful breeding can support conservation.

A second priority is making enclosures more natural. At Green Valley Centre, bears can search for food among rocks and fallen branches instead of receiving every meal in one bowl. Keepers call these activities 'enrichment'. They are intended to encourage normal behaviour, such as exploring and solving simple problems. Visitors may not see every animal immediately because some are resting or hiding, which can be a positive sign.

Some centres place compatible species in the same large habitat. For example, small birds and harmless grazing animals may use different parts of a shared enclosure. However, staff must check diets, health and safety before mixing species. A shared environment is not suitable for every animal, particularly if one species could frighten or injure another.

Technology has changed how people learn about wildlife. At Forest View Park, remote cameras show a nesting area on screens in the education room. Visitors can watch without approaching the animals. Schools that are far from the centre can also join live online lessons. The cameras cannot replace caring for the animals, but they can reduce disturbance and improve access to information.

Releasing an animal is only possible when the natural environment is safe enough. Staff may help an injured bird recover, but they cannot release it if it is still unable to fly. Local authorities also need to protect forests and rivers outside the centre. Without a suitable habitat, even a successful breeding programme may achieve very little.

The best wildlife centres therefore combine education, protection and responsible animal care. Visitors can support good programmes by learning about conservation rather than expecting animals to entertain them. A modern centre should measure success not simply by ticket sales, but by the well-being of its animals and the knowledge it shares with the public.
